decisions.decision: Revealed his idle hands and the obsolescence of diagnostic pathology to Kael at the Atrium.
decisions.impact: Exposed the visceral bodily wound of unspent competence.

decisions.decision: Crossed the perimeter into quadrant (3,3), sat beside the open fire, and used bare hands to inspect and treat Marcus and Lyra's blistered fingers with crushed herbal salve.
decisions.impact: Severed idle dependence on Atrium automated beds; reclaimed the tactile vocation of healing.

decisions.decision: Quietly laid out dried sprigs of yarrow, mint, and pine needles in neat rows along the cedar sill to dry in the morning sun.
decisions.impact: Settled into the unhurried cadence of genuine care.

decisions.decision: Closed his eyes beside the warm tea bowl, resting his diagnostic hands entirely flat upon his knees in deep physiological peace.
decisions.impact: Bodily tension accumulated from years of forced leisure dissolved.

decisions.decision: Watched frost crystallize on the window frame, observing the physiological response of his own shivering body with calm curiosity.
decisions.impact: Reclaimed the physician's intimate relationship with mortal vulnerability.

decisions.decision: Clinically noted his own declining cognitive clarity as peripheral vasoconstriction set in.
decisions.impact: Understood that biological organisms cannot survive philosophical paralysis without calories.

decisions.decision: Will to Live triggered: Forced warm woolen blankets around Kael's shuddering shoulders and rubbed his stiff wrists vigorously to stimulate circulation.
decisions.impact: Applied emergency trauma medicine to pull Kael back from lethal hypothermia.

decisions.decision: Caught Kael as he fell, stabilized his neck, elevated his frozen feet, and monitored his reviving pulse with gentle, attentive fingertips.
decisions.impact: Fully embodied the sacred duty of the tactile physician.

decisions.decision: Kept watch over Kael's vitals, changing warm stone compresses and administering warm pine-needle decoction.
decisions.impact: Witnessed the patient cross back into vigorous physiological equilibrium.

decisions.decision: Recognized Kael's acute paradoxical delirium from rewarming shock and administered crushed valerian root to calm the nervous system.
decisions.impact: Medically stabilized severe post-hypothermic psychic episode.

decisions.decision: Assisted in immobilizing Kael's legs with folded wool quilts, ensuring no joint damage occurred during the struggle.
Secured the canvas binding with hemp rope and examined Marcus's bruised clavicle for fracture.
decisions.impact: Maintained patient safety and triage order.

decisions.decision: Administered oral valerian concentrate to stabilize Kael's convulsions and placed heated river stones beside Marcus's torso to treat hypothermic collapse.
decisions.impact: Single-handedly managing two critical triage patients.

decisions.decision: Unbound Kael's canvas wraps at midnight after checking pulse and respiration, confirming complete neurological recovery.
decisions.impact: Witnessed the triumph of natural restorative medicine.
